stop: Stop publishing information that could expose aid movements

stop: Stop if data shared with unauthorized recipients

gate: Signed terms, incident chain, observer safety, neutral adjudicator

stop: Suspend benefits, not humanitarian relief, on independently upheld breach

gate: Consent, UNSC action where required, budget, operational safety

gate: Procurement controls, local consent, mine-action certification

owner: Member States, Ukrainian civil society and rights bodies (proposal)
